answer.new_information: NVIDIA said on 2026-07-02 that 12 games, including Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains, would join GeForce NOW in July 2026. It also described discounts on 12-month Performance and Ultimate memberships during the final days of the Summer Sale. These are gaming-service and promotional updates; they give no information about NVIDIA’s FY2027 disclosed commitments for guarantees or its possible guarantee for OpenAI’s Ohio data-center lease.
